initialExam.title: ACC Entry 2026 (Army Cadet College)
initialExam.description: Army Cadet College Entry for serving soldiers of the Indian Army to become commissioned officers. Soldiers undergo 3 years of training and get a graduation degree.
initialExam.eligibility: Serving soldiers of Indian Army with minimum 3 years of service, 12th pass
initialExam.syllabus: English, General Knowledge, Mathematics, Science (10+2 level).
initialExam.examPattern: Written Exam: Objective type, 200 marks. SSB Interview: 5 days.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → SSB Interview → Medical → Merit List → Training at ACC Wing, IMA
initialExam.jobRole: Commissioned Officer in Indian Army (from ranks)
initialExam.careerGrowth: Lieutenant → Captain → Major → Lieutenant Colonel → Colonel.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Apply through unit 2. Written exam 3. SSB Interview 4. Medical 5. Merit
initialExam.perks: MSP, DA, Kit allowance, Free accommodation, Medical, CSD, Leave Travel
